## Context

Darrell forwarded one digest with one word above the header: *"Lessons."* One item of it is the occasion for this week. The item reports two faults in the core of PHP, a repair shipped the day before, government sites switched off across Europe, and a researcher who used artificial intelligence to find the faults in the first place.

## The three truths, and why each is teaching rather than agreement

Every one of them cuts against a rule this house already holds, which is the whole reason the hour is worth holding.

**ONE — protective silence is stewardship, and it is not concealment.** The engineers withheld the fault while they built the repair. This house holds the opposite reflex: a run that did nothing must never report success (DR-1355), a gate that always passes is a lie (DR-0076 §3). So the line is drawn precisely rather than the posture being copied: **protective silence withholds the METHOD from an attacker while telling the DEFENDER exactly what to do; concealment withholds the DANGER from the person who bears it.** Nehemiah 2:12 and 2:16 look like a doctrine of secrecy until 2:18 **spends** the silence the instant the survey is done — and Amos 3:7 proves the direction by its destination: the secret goes to the servants, the ones who must act. The other arm is where real failure lives: Proverbs 28:13, the four men who convicted themselves for holding good news their starving city needed (2 Kings 7:9), the watchman who did not bring the sword and answers for the silence anyway (Ezekiel 33:6), Luke 12:2, Proverbs 27:12. Teach the test, not the posture.

**TWO — governments went dark on purpose.** Set honestly against **DR-0107**, this repository's own words after poetech.us served a stale build for about nine hours: a down site is the worst outcome. Both are true and the resolution is an **ordering**, not a contradiction: **uptime outranks delivery velocity; integrity outranks uptime.** Downtime chosen, announced, bounded and reversible is stewardship; downtime discovered because nobody was watching is the failure DR-0107 names. Isaiah 26:20 carries all three conditions in one verse — commanded, bounded to *a little moment*, named at its end — with Exodus 12:22, Nehemiah 7:3 (a gate that cannot be shut is a hole with hinges), Leviticus 13:46 and Genesis 7:16; and the order runs that way because the arithmetic precedes the groundbreaking (Luke 14:28) and the fire tries the WORK (1 Corinthians 3:13), not its availability record.

**THREE — the tool that found it is the tool that could take the server.** The course's own subject, stated without moralising: James 3:9-10 puts the verdict on the arrangement rather than the organ, Romans 6:13 asks for **yielding** rather than discarding, 1 Timothy 1:8 says the same of law, and the Word runs the same metal both directions on purpose (Isaiah 2:4 beside Joel 3:10), with a captured blade as the picture (1 Samuel 17:51) and Joseph's verdict over it (Genesis 50:20). A capability holds no loyalty; the only live question is the hand.

## Trust but verify — and what the checking CHANGED

**It reversed the draft's core assumption.** The draft had a clean picture: a disciplined team held the fault, finished the repair, released on its own schedule. The **PHP Foundation's own account** is that it was **caught off guard**, that the hold broke **early** and another company broke it, and that details leaked before the planned hour; earlier evidence of one fault had surfaced in an **outside audit in 2024**, after which the fix **stalled for months**. So the ethic stands and its **execution failed** — which makes the lesson stronger, and produced the sentence the gate now pins: **an agreement is not a mechanism.**

**NOT ONE PRIMARY SOURCE WAS OPENED, and the refusals are quoted rather than described (DR-0076 §8):** `curl: (56) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403` for `www.php.net`, `nvd.nist.gov`, `www.cisa.gov`, `php.watch` and `www.bsi.bund.de`; `getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND www.php.net`, `getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND www.csa.gov.sg` and `getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND itdaily.com`. Everything checked came through a search over **secondary** coverage — labeled a **mediated read** in all four non-child places. **ATTRIBUTED** to the publication and carried as theirs: roughly 70% of web sites, the August discovery, the named six countries. **UNCHECKED and staying unchecked:** that exact country list (reachable sources disagree and several add Czechia, Australia and Britain), and whether any attack succeeded anywhere. `re-review: 2026-12-06` — re-read once either host is allowed.

## What was measured

**Placement verified, not assumed:** 70 modules mounted on `origin/main` at `3a073d0c3`, weeks contiguous 1–70, ordered. So sov71 appended last, keeping `[1..71]` contiguous, pinned by `indexOf` and never by a last-element claim.

**Three references the taught catalog had never opened**, appearing in **no file** of `app/src` or `docs/decisions` (excluding `app/public/bible/xref/`): **Isaiah 26:20, Leviticus 13:46 and 1 Timothy 1:8.** Isaiah 26:20 is the ground the second movement stands on and the library had never once taught it. The other 32 are shared, **not one was dropped for it** (DR-1317), and the gate's census names the other holder for every one.

**THE SAME EVENT, THREE LANDINGS, named rather than avoided.** **sov66** (DR-1322, Morning Brew thread `1a163a78c1d14d84`, the **same day**) reads this same PHP defect for **unpriced protection** — a risk ranked low because the attacker was assumed weak. **spm11** (**#2570 / DR-1358**, from the University of Illinois cPanel advisory) reads it from the **local operator's chair** — an unsupported version cannot be patched, a mitigation is not a fix, there is no road back. **sov71** reads the **disclosure ethic and sovereignty.** Measured: **zero shared teaching references** with sov66 outside the seven standing Godhead-confession and growth verses every lesson in the course carries. Nehemiah 7:3 does carry the phrase sov70 and sov66 take from Nehemiah 3:28 — a **different verse**, read here for the gate shut on a **timetable**.

## Impact

The course gains the week that asks what the speed argument never asks — not *should we have told sooner* but *which direction was the silence pointing* — and three references the curriculum had never opened are now taught. **Seven findings came out of my own work rather than the source, every one of them caught by my own gate on its first run.** A quiz distractor named **Bishop Gwin** for a send that names nobody, the exact DR-0719 fault sov70's record had already recorded; it was **removed** rather than left as a wrong answer. Three bands were missing the DR-0100 tier labels. Two gate cases quoted my own prose inexactly. And **two cases were wrong in substance, not in spelling**: one claimed sov71 and sov66 shared *no* reference and went red on the seven standing verses every sibling carries by construction, and one forbade the words *inmate* and *Ukraine* outright and went red on the very sentence that declares those items unbuilt — naming something as unbuilt is not the same as teaching it. Both were corrected into the honest claim rather than deleted. **Nothing of a neighbour's was touched.**

## Decision

**sov71 ships as the Sovereign A.I. week on the disclosure ethic**, Word first, with its own pinned gate, honest in every reader place about never having opened a primary source. Both stories are `kind: 'parable'` — no real person's life stands behind either, so neither wears the testimony label and DR-1123's pin of 88 stays put. `scripts/file-budgets.json` takes its **fifth** recorded raise for this file (10289 → 10624), to the measured size and not above it, for the same stated reason as the four before it.
